dedupe_keys.name: harveststat africa crop statistics harmonization code

description: The HarvestStat Africa project publishes code for preparing and harmonizing subnational crop statistics in a public GitHub repository. Its own metadata states an MIT licence. The article says country-specific scripts and an aggregation step turn FEWS NET inputs into a consistent regional table aligned to changing administrative units. A modeller can inspect or adapt that workflow before using crop supply histories in food-network or agricultural transport simulations. Coverage is the 33-country HarvestStat Africa release, with the citable dataset held separately on Dryad. A caveat is that the scripts depend on original data sources, administrative crosswalks and project-specific cleaning choices; the GitHub code is not an agricultural production model. Users should pin a revision when reproducing the release. I read the own repository metadata, README and article code statement without cloning code, obtaining source statistics or checking output equality. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
